espn-2023-format.title: All 30 Major League Baseball teams to play one another in a season for first time in 2023
says: There are 52 total games against divisional opponents, down from 76.
Teams will play six or seven home/road games against divisional opponents.
There are 64 total games -- 32 home and 32 away -- against non-divisional league opponents, down from 66.
Teams will play six games against six league opponents and seven games against four league opponents.
There are 46 total games against interleague opponents, up from just 20.
All 30 MLB teams will be paired with a "natural rival" for a four-game interleague series, with each team hosting two games.
Teams will play 42 games against other interleague opponents, including seven series (21 games) at home and seven series (21 games) on the road.

Pairs: New York Mets-New York Yankees, Chicago Cubs-Chicago White Sox, LA Dodgers-LA Angels, San Francisco Giants-Oakland A's, Cincinnati Reds-Cleveland Guardians, Miami Marlins-Tampa Bay Rays, Washington Nationals-Baltimore Orioles, St. Louis Cardinals-Kansas City Royals, Milwaukee Brewers-Minnesota Twins, Atlanta Braves-Boston Red Sox, Pittsburgh Pirates-Detroit Tigers, Phila. espn-wildcard.title: How does MLB wild card work? Format, history, stats
says: Since 2022, three teams in each league earn a wild-card spot, bringing the total number of playoff teams to 12

During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, the postseason field was expanded to 16 total teams (eight per league)

espn-84.title: NHL releases expanded 84-game schedule for 2026-27 season
says: the league expands its campaign from 82 to 84 games this season.
The NHL has had an 82-game season since 1995-96.
Now, each team will play two home and two road games against its seven division rivals.
Teams will play two home games and one road game against four conference opponents, and one home game and two road games against the other four.
Teams will then play each opponent in the opposite conference once at home and once on the road for a total of 42 home games and 42 away games.

says: 16 teams will qualify for the Stanley Cup Playoffs.

Section headings: The First Round, The Second Round, Conference Finals & Stanley Cup Final

si-playoff-format.title: NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs: Format, Teams, Rules & Changes Through the Years
says: Sixteen teams qualify for the Stanley Cup playoffs.
The Stanley Cup playoffs comprise four rounds with winners determined by best-of-seven game series.
First-round winners advance to the second round.
Second-round winners move on to the conference finals.
The conference champions meet in the Stanley Cup Final.
Outside of the modified 2020 and 2021 tournaments due to COVID-19,
the NHL has used the same Stanley Cup playoffs format since 2013-14 when it introduced its current postseason setup.
si-playoff-format.note: The last two lines are one sentence, read again in the fix pass of the round.

years.2006: The 2007 playoffs: 16 clubs, fifteen series, every winner on four wins and none longer than seven games. Its round names: Conference Quarter-Finals (8), Conference Semi-Finals (4), Conference Finals (2), Final.

si-overtime.title: NHL Overtime Rules Explained: Playoffs and Regular Season
says: if the game is still tied after the opening three 20-minute periods
Rather than the usual 5-on-5 format, NHL overtime is played 3-on-3.
since 2015, the NHL has adopted a 3-on-3 format for the overtime period in the regular season.
If the game is still tied after five minutes, teams go to a penalty shootout to determine the winner.
After 2005, the league introduced the shootout to determine a winner and a loser.
When a regular-season NHL game goes to overtime, both teams are awarded a single point.
Each team gets three initial penalty takers to determine the outcome.
There are no shootouts in playoff hockey.
a 20-minute, sudden-death overtime period until a winner is determined

there were four skaters on each side, but the NHL adopted the three-on-three format at the start of the 2015-16 season.
